# pocketid Provider

Interact with Pocket-ID OIDC provider. Pocket-ID is a simple and easy-to-use OIDC provider
that allows users to authenticate with their passkeys to your services.

This provider is an independent project: it began as a fork of
[Trozz/terraform-provider-pocketid](https://github.com/Trozz/terraform-provider-pocketid)
and is maintained on its own, with its own version numbers (see
[UPSTREAM.md](https://github.com/irashack/terraform-provider-pocketid/blob/main-maintenance/UPSTREAM.md)).
Release 3.0.0 supports Pocket ID 2.14.0 through 2.17.0. It is not published to a
provider registry: install a verified archive from its
[GitHub releases](https://github.com/irashack/terraform-provider-pocketid/releases)
through a native filesystem mirror under the source address
`registry.terraform.io/irashack/pocketid`, as the
[installation guide](https://github.com/irashack/terraform-provider-pocketid/blob/main-maintenance/INSTALL.md)
describes, before initializing the example.

3.0.0 has deliberate breaking changes from 2.4.x, each marked **Breaking** in the
[changelog](https://github.com/irashack/terraform-provider-pocketid/blob/main-maintenance/CHANGELOG.md).
The [README](https://github.com/irashack/terraform-provider-pocketid/blob/main-maintenance/README.md)
lists every resource and data source and how this provider differs from upstream.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    pocketid = {
      source  = "registry.terraform.io/irashack/pocketid"
      version = "3.0.0"
    }
  }
}

# Configure the Pocket-ID Provider
provider "pocketid" {
  # The base URL of your Pocket-ID instance
  base_url = "https://pocket-id.example.com"

  # API token for authentication
  # This can also be set via the POCKETID_API_TOKEN environment variable
  api_token = var.pocketid_api_token

  # Optional: Skip TLS certificate verification (only for development)
  # skip_tls_verify = true

  # Optional: HTTP client timeout in seconds (default: 30)
  # timeout = 60
}

# Variable for API token to avoid hardcoding sensitive values
variable "pocketid_api_token" {
  description = "API token for Pocket-ID authentication"
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_token` (String, Sensitive) API token for authentication. Can also be set via POCKETID_API_TOKEN environment variable.
- `base_url` (String) Base URL of the Pocket-ID instance. Can also be set via POCKETID_BASE_URL environment variable.
- `skip_tls_verify` (Boolean) Skip TLS certificate verification. Default is false. Only use this for development/testing.
- `timeout` (Number) HTTP client timeout in seconds. Default is 30.
